1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 70 cm de longitud, de rostro largo y puntiagudo, con un par de caninos grandes en la mandíbula superior, cuerpo alto, plateado, y un característico color amarillo en las aletas y la cola; es comestible. Lutjanidae, Lutjanus apodus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 70 cm in length, characterized by a long and pointed snout, with two large canine teeth on the upper jaw, an elevated body, silvery coloration, and distinctive yellow markings on the fins and tail; it is edible. Family Lutjanidae, species Lutjanus apodus.
